seo.description: Video editing, motion graphics, sound design and video production work created for The Dot HQ across podcasts, software communication and company storytelling.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This collection brings together four video projects created for The Dot HQ across different communication needs: two podcast productions, a software update video and a company introduction. The work ranges from long-form conversational editing to product communication and brand storytelling, with a consistent focus on pacing, clarity, motion and sound.

sections.heading: Project snapshot
sections.role: Video Editor & Motion Designer; Videographer on the software update video

sections.heading: What I handled
sections.body: The scope changed slightly by format, but the core responsibility was shaping raw footage and information into clear, watchable finished pieces.

items.title: Editing & pacing
items.body: Structured the footage through cuts, timing and sequencing so conversations and company information stayed focused without feeling over-edited.

items.title: Motion & sound
items.body: Created intros, motion graphics, subtle animations and sound treatment where required to strengthen transitions, emphasis and overall finish.

items.title: Production when required
items.body: For the software update video, I handled the shoot as well as the complete post-production process, allowing the visual capture and final edit to work as one system.

sections.heading: 01 — Five-Year Milestone Podcast
sections.body: A special podcast produced around The Dot HQ's five-year milestone. I handled the complete post-production — cuts, pacing, intro treatment, motion graphics, sound work and final assembly — while the filming itself was handled separately.

sections.heading: 02 — Podcast Episode
sections.body: For this podcast, I again handled the complete edit after filming: shaping the conversation through clean cuts, building the intro, adding motion graphics and refining the sound and pacing for a polished long-form result.

sections.heading: 03 — Software Update Video
sections.body: This project covered both production and post-production. I shot the video and then handled the edit, pacing, motion elements, sound treatment and final delivery, keeping the software-focused information clear and visually engaging.

sections.heading: 04 — Company Introduction Video
sections.body: A brand-led company introduction where the post-production carried much of the storytelling. I handled the full edit together with motion design, sound design and subtle animation to give the piece energy while keeping the company message professional and easy to follow.

sections.heading: Across the four videos
sections.body: The collection shows the range I bring to video work: long-form editorial judgement, motion-led brand communication, sound design and hands-on production when a project needs it.
